parts.content: Write code/artifacts, not research only. In workspace d:\PropelExp, generate the remaining task markdown files for the previously researched 58-task inventory covering EP-TECH US_001..US_005, EP-001 US_011..US_015, EP-002 US_016..US_020. Do NOT overwrite the existing validated .propel/context/tasks/EP-TECH/us_001/task_001_scaffold_frontend_app.md. Create all other inventory files using apply_patch only. Follow the authoritative task-template exactly: Task heading; Requirement Reference; conditional Design References only for tasks with UI impact; conditional AI References only for tasks with direct AIR impact; no Mobile section; Applicable Technology Stack; Task Overview; Dependent Tasks; Impacted Components; Implementation Plan; Current Project State; Expected Changes; External References; Build Commands; Implementation Validation Strategy; Implementation Checklist. One technology layer per task file, 1-8 checklist items, <=8 estimated hours represented in planning but do not add template-external sections. Every checklist item maps to an AC. No unit-test implementation checklist items for feature tasks and no downstream workflow invocations. Test-layer tasks may plan test implementation as their purpose. Use exact locked versions: React 19.3, TypeScript 7.0, Vite 8.3, Node 24 LTS, Python 3.14.7, FastAPI 0.141.1, OpenAPI 3.1.0, JSON Schema 2020-12, adapter contract v1. Do not invent exact versions for unspecified libraries. For AI provider fields use N/A because no provider is approved; ports/schema tasks remain provider-neutral. Use the story-local sequence and snake_case slug filenames task_XXX_<slug>.md. Respect the task inventory returned earlier in this session. Read each source story directly to ensure exact ACs, edge cases, parent epic, dependencies, visual references, and tags. Source code does not exist, so expected changes must be CREATE paths grounded in design.md; do not claim existing application modules. Keep each file concise but fully populated. After creation, report created file count and any failures. Do not create any files outside the story task directories.
